intro.headline: Your own app store. On your own hardware.
intro.subhead: Umbrel turns any Raspberry Pi or old computer into a beautiful home server — install self-hosted apps in one click, no terminal required.

outro.headline: Stop renting the cloud. Build your own.
outro.subhead: Umbrel is free, runs on hardware you already own, and installs in about ten minutes. Which app are you putting on it first?
